turns.q: I placed an order a few days ago and still have no tracking, where is it?
turns.replyTail:
Hey Bestie!

Thanks for reaching out to us.

I would love to help you track down your order! To get started, could you please share a few quick details with me:

Your order number
Your email address
Your phone number

Once I have those, I will look right into it for you 🙂

If you have any more questions, feel free to ask.

Evry Customer Specialist

turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
Most orders ship out from our Toronto warehouse within 1 to 2 business days. Once your order ships, you will receive a tracking number via email or text. Please keep in mind that tracking information can take up to 3 business days to update after shipment.

Orders ship within 1 to 2 business days
Tracking number sent upon dispatch
Tracking updates take up to 3 business days

turns.q: Once it ships, how long is delivery?

Standard delivery typically takes 3 to 7 business days for orders within the US and Canada.

Standard delivery: 3 to 7 business days (US and Canada)
Express shipping: 1 to 2 business days (US only, if selected)

turns.q: Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?
turns.replyTail:
Unfortunately, we aren't able to speed up or rush an order once it has been placed, and shipping speeds cannot be upgraded after checkout. Our team works hard to get all orders processed and shipped out as quickly as possible 🙂

turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
turns.replyTail:
Tracking information can take up to 3 business days to update after your order ships. If there are still no tracking updates after that time, or if tracking hasn't moved for 5 to 8 days, feel free to reach back out to us so we can look into it for you 🙂

turns.q: How do I find my tracking link?
turns.replyTail:
You can find your tracking link in the shipping confirmation email or SMS sent to you once your order has been dispatched. You can also view your tracking details by logging into your Order Dashboard at https://account.evryjewels.com/orders/ or via our tracking portal at https://account.evryjewels.com/?lang=en 🙂

turns.q: Can I reroute the package to a different address?
turns.replyTail:
Shipping addresses can only be updated within 30 minutes of placing your order using our Edit Order Portal. Once an order has been processed or shipped, we are unfortunately unable to reroute it or change the delivery address 🙂

turns.q: Do you compensate for a long delay?
turns.replyTail:
Unfortunately, we are unable to provide compensation for shipping or delivery delays, as carriers can occasionally experience unexpected transit updates and delays out of our control. We truly appreciate your patience and understanding 🙂
